aspect: Står med fötterna parallellt, riktade rakt fram
rationale: SAT stance width normalised to hip width measures whether feet are placed parallel and symmetrically

aspect: Står med fötterna rakt under höftlederna
rationale: SAT absolute stance width measures foot placement distance relative to hip width/ SAT hip-normalised stance ratio confirms feet are positioned directly under the hip joints
SAT knee asymmetry measures left-right knee alignment. neutral alignment points kneecaps toward middle toes/ SAT left-right knee angle difference captures bilateral kneecap direction asymmetry

SAT left knee flexion angle confirms the required semi-flexed starting position/ SAT right knee flexion angle confirms the required semi-flexed starting position/ SAT mean knee forward position captures the anterior tibial inclination in the semi-flexed stance
SAT trunk sagittal angle captures pelvis orientation in the starting posture/ MoLab pelvis tilt is added because it measures slight anterior pelvic tilt more directly than SAT

aspect: Thorakalrygg i neutral kyfos i sagittalplan
rationale: SAT overall trunk sagittal angle captures thoracic spinal curvature in the sagittal plane/ SAT head-trunk angle reflects the upper thoracic and cervical contribution to kyphosis

aspect: Huvudet symmetrisk position rakt ovanför bålen
rationale: SAT head-trunk angle measures whether the head is symmetrically positioned directly above the trunk

aspect: Cervikalrygg i neutral lordos i sagittalplan
rationale: SAT head-trunk angle serves as an indirect measure of cervical lordosis via head position relative to trunk

aspect: Axlarna symmetriska och i samma nivå
rationale: SAT shoulder asymmetry directly quantifies whether shoulders are level and symmetric
SAT wrist acceleration during descent is low when upper arms remain neutral along the body without active rotation

aspect: Bålen placerad rakt över bäckenet i sagittalplan
rationale: SAT trunk sagittal angle confirms trunk is positioned upright and aligned over pelvis/ MoLab pelvis tilt confirms neutral pelvis position under the trunk in sagittal plane

aspect: Bålen fortsätter fällas framåt och höftböjningen fortskrider
rationale: SAT trunk ROM confirms the total forward lean range during the continued descent/ SAT hip flexion ROM directly quantifies continued hip bending during the descent

aspect: Knäna fortsätter böjas och rör sig framåt initialt.
rationale: SAT knee flexion ROM measures how much the knees continue to bend and advance forward/ SAT mean knee forward position quantifies the horizontal knee displacement over the toes

aspect: Knäna bibehålls riktade mot mellersta tån
rationale: SAT knee asymmetry measures whether both knees maintain symmetric forward direction in fas 1/ MoLab left-right knee angle difference directly quantifies kneecap alignment toward the middle toe/ MoLab lateral pelvis tilt in fas 1 reflects lower-limb frontal-plane alignment

SAT peak vertical pelvis velocity captures the maximum downward speed. high values indicate uncontrolled drop/ SAT RMS vertical pelvis acceleration quantifies smoothness of descent. high values indicate jerkiness

aspect: Förflyttar bäckenet bakåt/nedåt kontrollerat och symmetriskt
rationale: SAT posterior pelvis displacement quantifies the controlled backward-downward pelvis trajectory/ SAT vertical pelvis descent confirms controlled lowering toward the seat/ MoLab pelvis acceleration is added as a compact 3D control measure for the final backward-downward transfer

aspect: Knäna bibehålls riktade mot mellersta tån
rationale: SAT knee asymmetry measures whether knees remain directed toward the middle toe during final descent

aspect: Händer/armar följer med i rörelsen utan aktivt mothåll mot armstöd/sits
rationale: SAT wrist acceleration measures whether hands and arms follow passively without active midline crossing
